name: Scaleway Serverless Containers

evidence.paas: 03: fully managed serverless container hosting; Scaleway runs the infrastructure and scaling

line: Run stateless HTTP containers with managed scaling and deployment.

work.math: One instance for 730 hours uses €0 of compute under unused monthly allowances. The assumed 1 GB registry adds €0.027. This allocation has not been load-tested for 1 million requests.

Compute for 730 hours is €24.28 for CPU + €4.456 for RAM. The assumed 1 GB registry adds €0.027. Assumes free quotas are unused elsewhere. The billing FAQ conflicts on how runtime and requests are metered.
Known subtotal €41.144, plus €0.03 times the average retained backup GB. Assumes 730 hours and a 10 GB database volume. Actual snapshots and private database traffic costs are not confirmed.
